title: StratumTracker transitions race and can regress replay/time state
description: Correctness/robustness review: StratumTracker has no lock across expiry, validation, replay high-water checks, adoption, clear, reads, or admin reset. Concurrent providers can validate against stale state; same-signer counters can commit out of order and regress the high-water mark, and an older sample can overwrite a newer reference. Serialize every read and transition under one reentrant lock and add barrier-controlled same-signer and competing-source races.
